frame.origin: building centre on the ground plane
frame.x: +x streamwise (wind at WD = 0 blows toward +x); building x in [-0.04, 0.04]
frame.y: +y lateral; building y in [-0.04, 0.04]; points published on the y <= 0 half
frame.length_scale: model metres (the source states no model:full scale ratio)

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: generated from the readme's stated dimensions b = 0.08 m, H = 2b = 0.16 m, centred on the origin (MP-z_caseA.png)
